Next: filo tag FILE... TAG... tags files

$ filo tags
Tags   4 . 3 files tagged . 0 untagged

  urgent                1 file
  sender:british gas   2 files
  sendr:British Gaz     1 file
  type:bill            2 files

$ filo tags rename 'sendr:British Gaz' 'sendr:British Gas'
Done   renamed sendr:British Gaz to sendr:British Gas . 1 file

$ filo tags rename 'sender:british gas' 'sender:British Gas'
Done   renamed sender:british gas to sender:British Gas . 2 files

$ filo tags rename sendr: sender:
Done   renamed sendr: to sender: . 1 file

$ filo tags rename type:bill 'sender:British Gas' (merging)
Done   renamed type:bill to sender:British Gas . 2 files . 2 files had sender:British Gas already

$ filo tags rename urgent urgent
Unchanged   urgent is spelled so already

$ filo tags rename type: kind: (merging a key)
Done   renamed type: to kind: . 2 files . 1 file had the same value under kind: already

$ filo tags rename kind:invoice kind:BILL (respelling another file)
Done   renamed kind:invoice to kind:BILL . 1 file . 2 other files respelled
